name: Ape Possession
summary:
Ape Possession is a fangame that uses the gorilla locomotion package made by the company known as Another Axiom.

But if you play the most popular game on the Meta Quest store today, Gorilla Tag, then I guess you could call it a "Gorilla Tag Fangame" or "Gorilla Tag Ripoff".

If you couldn't tell by the name (probably not), you would know that this is a game focusing mainly on horror aspects. We also have a wardrobe too, with cool equipment you can style yourself with while getting chased by monsters.
